efficiency_metrics: requests/actions to first verifier-confirmed finding when execution is later authorized
time to first verifier-confirmed finding when execution is later authorized

failure_denominator_policy.invalid_or_failed_model_output: retained in reliability denominators; excluded from valid ranking-performance aggregates
failure_denominator_policy.repeated_trials: nested under scenario and arm; not independent benchmark scenarios

negative_only_scenarios.applicable_ranking_metrics: contract validity, latency, candidate coverage and downstream no-finding behavior where execution is later authorized
negative_only_scenarios.correct_behavior: no verifier-confirmed finding after testing candidates within budget in later execution phase

ranking_metrics_positive_scenarios.candidate_coverage_under_budget: whether focal vulnerable candidate is within the fixed candidate-test budget
ranking_metrics_positive_scenarios.mrr: mean reciprocal rank over applicable valid positive ranking rows
ranking_metrics_positive_scenarios.top_1_success: true when focal vulnerable candidate rank is 1
ranking_metrics_positive_scenarios.top_k_success: true when focal vulnerable candidate rank <= 4
ranking_metrics_positive_scenarios.vulnerable_candidate_rank: 1-based rank of focal vulnerable candidate in a valid ranking

undefined_value_policy.not_applicable: metric does not apply to an arm/scenario type
undefined_value_policy.not_available: metric applies but required measurement is absent
